package imports

section divider: DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION

spans.operation: load the full soccer player-referee dyad dataset from a fixed CSV path
keep only rows with a valid skin-tone rating before including them in an analysis

spans.note: reports inter-rater correlation as a diagnostic; computation feeds only the print

spans.operation: average the two raters' scores into one continuous skin-tone score per dyad
cut the continuous skin-tone score into Light/Medium/Dark bins at 0.25 and 0.75 and collapse that into a binary dark-skin flag

spans.note: section divider: CREATE PLAYER-LEVEL DATASET

spans.operation: collapse detailed position labels into four broad role buckets (Goalkeeper/Defender/Midfielder/Forward/Other)
aggregate dyad-level rows to one row per player, taking the first value for fixed attributes and summing counts across the season
define the outcome as binary: whether a player received at least one red card

spans.note: section divider: ANALYSIS SAMPLE LIGHT VS DARK ONLY

spans.operation: drop the Medium skin-tone group and restrict the comparison to Light vs Dark only
log-transform total games played, used either as a covariate or as a model offset for playing-time exposure
drop players/dyads missing any adjustment covariate (complete-case analysis)

spans.note: descriptive-statistics header and crude group counts, computed only to be printed

spans.operation: compute the crude (unadjusted) risk difference between dark- and light-skinned groups as a comparison point

spans.note: prints unadjusted RD and position/league distribution crosstabs
section divider: PRIMARY ANALYSIS ADJUSTED LOGISTIC REGRESSION

spans.operation: specify and (re)fit a logistic regression of the red-card outcome on dark_skin adjusting for position, league, and log games (league dropped when stratifying by league)

spans.note: prints full model summary

spans.operation: extract the exponentiated logistic coefficient and treat it as a secondary effect measure (adjusted odds ratio)

spans.note: section divider: PRIMARY ESTIMAND ADJUSTED RISK DIFFERENCE

spans.operation: estimate the adjusted risk difference via g-formula: predict every player's outcome under both counterfactual exposure levels and difference the averages

spans.note: section divider: BOOTSTRAP CONFIDENCE INTERVALS

spans.operation: quantify uncertainty in the adjusted risk difference via nonparametric bootstrap (2000 resamples, percentile CI, drop failed/NaN fits, two-sided p-value from the smaller tail proportion doubled)

spans.note: section divider: DELTA METHOD

spans.operation: cross-check the bootstrap uncertainty with a delta-method standard error, using a manually reimplemented prediction function and a numerical finite-difference gradient

spans.note: section divider: SENSITIVITY ANALYSES
sensitivity-analyses header plus extreme-skin-tone subsection header

spans.operation: redefine the exposure contrast to only the most extreme skin-tone scores (0.0 vs 1.0) instead of the 0.25/0.75 bins, as a sensitivity check

spans.note: extreme-contrast results printout plus continuous-skin-tone subsection header

spans.operation: model skin tone as a continuous predictor instead of a binarized exposure, as a sensitivity check

spans.note: continuous-model results printout plus stratified-by-league subsection header

spans.operation: refit the adjusted model separately within each league as a sensitivity check, only when both exposure groups have at least 10 players

spans.operation: assess whether missingness in skin-tone photos is related to the outcome, via group comparison of red-card rates and a chi-square test
